title: Ear-gate A/B set: levers baseline vs shipping candidate, N=2 serving artifact
purpose: Fraser's listening session to ratify the depth-decoder levers (BREEZE_DD_FUSED=1 + BREEZE_DD_FLASH_ATTN=1) before deployment. Per collaborator decision: A/B is baseline (FUSED=0 FLASH=0) vs shipping candidate (FUSED=1 FLASH=1), both voices, with a fused-only diagnostic.
prompt: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. We are benchmarking the Breeze TTS two model on the Radeon 780 M graphics card, measuring the real time factor of the full generation pipeline from the text encoder through the backbone and depth decoder.
provenance_checks: calliope-baseline md5 == N=2 baseline probe wav (dd9-depth-lever-probe.json n2_probe.baseline): bit-identical across a 30-minute gap — deterministic audio confirmed at seed 42 on the N=2 artifact
calliope-candidate md5 == N=2 combined probe wav: same

expected_lengths.steward_pair: voice-dependent; sizes 898.6 KB vs 887.1 KB (~18.7 s vs ~18.5 s)

gate_rule: Both candidate clips (calliope + steward) must sound natural and free of artifacts vs their baselines. If a candidate clip fails, the fused-only diagnostic isolates whether the fused sampling path (vs the flash kernel) is the cause; FLASH=1 alone remains the fallback configuration (dd9-depth-lever-probe.json).
